+def _route(data, exact, minimum_duration):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bits = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    source = data["source"]
+    initial_mask = bits.get(source, 0)
+    start = data["start"]
+    initial_used = 0
+    best = {(source, initial_mask, initial_used): start}
+    queue = [(start, source, initial_mask, initial_used)]
+
+    while queue:
+        arrival, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        if best.get((node, mask, used)) != arrival:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full and (not exact or used == data["coupons"]):
+            return {"arrival": arrival}
+
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(arrival, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            choices = [(edge["duration"], used)]
+            if used < data["coupons"]:
+                duration = max(minimum_duration,
+                               edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                choices.append((duration, used + 1))
+            for duration, next_used in choices:
+                next_time = depart + duration
+                if next_time > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bits.get(next_node, 0)
+                key = (next_node, next_mask, next_used)
+                if next_time < best.get(key, float("inf")):
+                    best[key] = next_time
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (next_time, next_node, next_mask, next_used))
+    return {"arrival": None}
+
+
+def _build_route(exact, minimum_duration):
+    return lambda data: _route(data, exact, minimum_duration)
+

+def _build_ledger():
+    def rounded(numerator, denominator, mode):
+        quotient, remainder = divmod(numerator, denominator)
+        if mode == "half_up" and 2 * remainder >= denominator:
+            quotient += 1
+        return quotient
